observations: Photo 0 shows a chest freezer with a light gray exterior and a stainless steel lid and handle.
The freezer has a sticker on the front that reads '120 HOURS COOLING RETENTION' and '3 YEARS WARRANTY'.
There is a control panel with a dial and two buttons on the lower right side of the front.
The freezer appears to be in a room with a concrete floor and a light-colored wall.
The surface of the freezer is dusty and shows some wear, including a small white sticker or mark near the bottom left.
The brand name is partially visible on the top left corner of the lid, but not fully legible.
The seller claims it is 250-liter capacity, low voltage, 120-hour cooling retention, and in working condition.

claims.evidence: The capacity is not visible on the freezer in the photo. The sticker mentions '120 HOURS COOLING RETENTION' but not the capacity.
No visible power rating or voltage label on the freezer. The claim cannot be verified from the photo alone.
The sticker on the front of the freezer clearly states '120 HOURS COOLING RETENTION'.
No visual proof of operation is shown. The freezer appears dusty and worn, but functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The freezer may not be 250-liter capacity as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo showing the model label or a label with capacity printed on it.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a smaller capacity freezer, which would reduce value.

risks.risk: The freezer may not be in working condition.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the freezer running, with the door closed and the interior light on, or a photo of the power cord and plug.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which would significantly reduce value.

risks.risk: The freezer may have internal damage or frost buildup not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A photo of the interior of the freezer, showing the walls, shelves, and frost condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged or inefficient, which would reduce value.

proof_requests: Photo of the model label or any label showing the capacity and brand.
Video or photo of the freezer running, showing the interior and power cord.
Photo of the interior of the freezer, showing the condition of the walls and shelves.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
